Deepcool AN600 Low Profile CPU Cooler – Compact Cooling, Maximum Performance

The Deepcool AN600 is a premium low-profile CPU cooler designed for small form factor (SFF) and mini-ITX builds. With a sleek 67mm height, it fits perfectly in compact cases without compromising on cooling efficiency. Equipped with a powerful 120mm PWM fan and a dense aluminum fin stack, the AN600 delivers excellent thermal performance while maintaining ultra-quiet operation.

Compatible with both Intel and AMD sockets, this cooler is ideal for gamers, content creators, and PC enthusiasts looking for space-saving thermal solutions. Whether you're building a slim HTPC or a powerful mini gaming rig, the Deepcool AN600 ensures your system stays cool under load.


Key Features:

  • Ultra-compact 67mm low-profile design
  • 6 high-performance heatpipes for efficient heat dissipation
  • 120mm high-airflow PWM fan with low noise output
  • Wide compatibility with Intel LGA1700/1200/115x & AMD AM5/AM4 sockets
  • Easy installation for SFF and mini-ITX cases
